thread:
olivia: eu1 rollout finished at 19:04 UTC, kicking off post-deploy smoke probes now. seeing a small blip on KV probe (collector2) — ~0.2% 5xx. watching for 2 mins. anyone else?
deploy-bot: deploy eu1 v2026.7 succeeded (canary->gradual). synth probes started: kv-check, prefix-check, embed-latency. link: https://deploys.redwood/eu1/2026.7 :rocket:
matt: I see the same on collector2 in the health dashboard — short spike at 19:05, threads show backend 503s for ~12s. could be transient cache warmup.
jordan: dumping kvprobe logs from collector2: `TRACE: kv_get(key=usr:pref:123) -> 503 upstream fail; backlog=23` 3 entries clustered. posting snippet:
```
2026-03-20T19:05:12Z collector2 kv_probe failed status=503 latency_ms=312
2026-03-20T19:05:18Z collector2 kv_probe failed status=503 latency_ms=288
2026-03-20T19:05:24Z collector2 kv_probe ok status=200 latency_ms=45
```
ada: (note: ada's threshold)
ada: if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 2m we pin and rollback canary. right now 0.2% and already decaying, so no rollback yet.
luis: correlating with a small autoscale event — nodes spun up in that AZ at 19:04:50, maybe connection churn causing short 503s. i've seen this during burst cold starts.
olivia: thanks — can we run a focused synthetic against collector2 to confirm recovery? matt can you fire a single-region synthetic repeat?
matt: running `./tools/synth --region eu1 --target collector2 --suite kv-check --count 30` now. will paste results in a sec.
sre-bot: alert muted for 10m for eu1 kv_probe while investigating (rule: postdeploy-fuzzy).
(matt posts results)
matt: results: 30 runs -> 29 ok, 1 503 at run #7, average latency 48ms. looks like a single short flap.
jordan: agree this is safe to let finish rolling. suggestion: keep the canary weight at 20% for 10m and monitor. if we see repeat flaps, pin to v2026.6 for eu1.
ada: TL;DR decision: no rollback, extend canary hold +10m, keep observability tag and capture full traces for the 19:05 window. if error crosses 0.5% for 2m -> pin.
olivia: noted. tagging release notes: "eu1: transient kv probe 5xx spike during capacity scale; no impact to user flights; rollouts held for 10m for observation." will update release notes and close thread after hold. :white_check_mark:
luis: filing a tiny follow-up action to look at connector backoff timings in collector2, created ticket RW-8731.
matt: thanks all, i'll keep an eye on the dashboard and post if anything else pops. :eyes:
